# Published JSON Schemas

Source: `provenant-records print-wire-schemas`.

Each file is a JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) for the `--json` envelope of one
command, or for an MCP tool's `structuredContent`. `schema_version` is bumped for
any change an existing consumer could misread; a new version replaces the old
one with no dual-emit period.

| Schema | Describes |
|---|---|
| [`cancel.schema.json`](schemas/cancel.schema.json) | provenant cancel --json |
| [`error.schema.json`](schemas/error.schema.json) | provenant error envelope |
| [`lanes.schema.json`](schemas/lanes.schema.json) | provenant lanes --json |
| [`mcp/fabric_output.schema.json`](schemas/mcp/fabric_output.schema.json) | fabric_output structuredContent |
| [`mcp/fabric_run.schema.json`](schemas/mcp/fabric_run.schema.json) | fabric_run structuredContent |
| [`output.schema.json`](schemas/output.schema.json) | provenant output --json |
| [`status.schema.json`](schemas/status.schema.json) | provenant status --json |

## Edge error codes

Stable `error.code` values emitted outside the run owner (those are listed in the
[CLI reference](cli.md#error-codes)). `legacy_spelling` codes keep the spelling
consumers already match on; `umbrella` codes cover a command family until an
owner splits them.

| Code | Kind | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `SIGNIN_PROBE` | specific | The provider sign-in probe failed. |
| `UNKNOWN_HOST` | specific | No configured peer has this host label. |
| `PEER` | umbrella | The peer host returned an error. |
| `SUMMARY_STALE` | specific | The chair summary changed since it was read; reread and reapply. |
| `ACCOUNT_SYNC` | specific | The account was registered, but syncing managed content failed. |
| `ACCOUNT` | umbrella | An account command failed. |
| `EXPERIMENT_REPORT` | specific | The experiment report failed. |
| `DISK` | umbrella | A disk command failed. |
| `ENCODE` | specific | The disk report could not be encoded. |
| `GC` | umbrella | Garbage collection failed. |
| `UPGRADE_FAILED` | specific | Some hosts failed to upgrade; inspect host results and rerun. |
| `PR` | umbrella | A pull request command failed. |
| `QUOTA` | umbrella | A quota command failed. |
| `REVIEW_UNBOUND` | specific | A review attempt could not be bound to its review. |
| `REVIEW_INCOMPLETE` | specific | Review coverage does not support acceptance. |
| `IN_LANE` | specific | A lane cannot register or save a chair session. |
| `SESSION_PROJECT` | specific | The workflow session is registered under a different project. |
| `launch_unknown` | legacyspelling | The launch handoff was not confirmed (same meaning as LAUNCH_UNKNOWN). |
| `owner_local_only` | legacyspelling | The inbox owner must run this operation on the owner host or from the owning chair session. |
| `unsupported_owner` | legacyspelling | The peer does not support inbox operations. |
| `console_app_unavailable` | legacyspelling | The console app cannot be opened. |
| `reconcile_incomplete` | legacyspelling | Reconcile could not settle everything it found. |
| `cli_failed` | legacyspelling | A delegated Provenant command failed without a code of its own. |
